call_report.reason: historical call, candidate selector, exact block and runtime proof align
call_report.limits: The ABI signature and return layout are reviewer assertions. Historical RPC returns are not locally executed or proved; the supplied header is not independently authenticated. Selector presence does not prove reachability, and this report gives no freshness, state-effect, authority or future-execution guarantee.

dependency_frontier.scope: Same-block raw state/header/runtime proof replay, followed by bounded structural scanning of every proved source or discovered-target runtime. Only locally constant decoded external-call operands can request more proofs; unresolved operands remain open. Structural sites can be unreachable or metadata. This is not EVM execution, complete dependency discovery, authenticated consensus, source equivalence, current-state proof, safety review or transaction approval.

limits: The frontier is a structural scan of supplied proved runtimes, not call-specific execution or reachability. Open sites might be irrelevant to this call; no-open-sites does not establish complete dependencies. Proof inclusion is relative to an unauthenticated supplied header. Call returns and reviewer ABI choices remain unproved. No freshness, permission, economic safety, state effects or future execution is established.
